_comment: Day 17: an S3-style bucket policy on 'northwind-customer-invoices'.
_intent: Only the invoicing service (role: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/invoicing-svc) should read/write objects. Customers get their invoice via a signed URL the app generates - they never touch the bucket directly.
_your_task: 1. Who can currently read the invoices? (careful: Principal is '*')
2. What's the over-grant, and why is s3:ListBucket especially bad here?
3. Rewrite so ONLY the invoicing-svc role can GetObject/PutObject on the objects, and nobody can ListBucket.
4. Name one AWS account-level setting that would have blocked this regardless of the policy. (hint: 'Block Public Access')
